summary: Frontend-only verification of Skali login page on preview URL. Confirmed no webpack 'Compiled with problems' overlay, Skali login renders, DOB picker clamping works correctly for leap years (Feb 2000 -> 29, Feb 2001 -> 28, April disables 31), year max = current year - 13 (2013), and all API calls route to https://clanchatapp-backend.onrender.com with successful CORS (access-control-allow-origin: *).
critical_code_review_comments: DobPicker useEffect clamp dependency only includes maxDay but setD(maxDay) runs on initial mount when d=0 and maxDay=31; harmless but React may warn missing deps (d). Non-blocking.
React Router v7 future flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) - informational, not a bug.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth submission performed per request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://birthday-picker-1.preview.emergentagent.com serves root Vite build. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/.env points to Render backend (production). Do not submit registration. DobPicker testIds: register-dob-{day|month|year}-select.
verified_items: Warmup calls go to https://clanchatapp-backend.onrender.com/api/ with CORS allow-origin: *
